submission.justification: Algorithm-L1 with a 30 GeV threshold achieves the highest signal efficiency of 93.29% at the allocated 8 kHz trigger rate. Through systematic simulation across the allowed threshold range (20-60 GeV), I found that Algorithm-L1 consistently outperforms the other candidates: Algorithm-L2 peaks at 86.08% (40 GeV) and Algorithm-L3 peaks at 74.48% (35 GeV). The 30 GeV threshold represents the optimal operating point for Algorithm-L1, providing approximately 7 percentage points improvement over Algorithm-L2 and 19 percentage points over Algorithm-L3. All three algorithms are deployable within the Level-1 hardware constraints (FPGA resources and optical link bandwidth), making Algorithm-L1 the clear choice for maximizing physics performance.
